newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein edges higher on demand.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein edges higher on demand.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices extended gains in late trading on Wednesday as buyers swarmed the market amid tight supply, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,445-50 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, up from 1,440-45 rupiah at the opening and 1,430-35 rupiah at Tuesday's close.
"The market was hot," one trader said. "Buyers were coming back into the market in a big way because of tight supply due to increased exports to Europe."
"Many sellers closed early for the day because they are expecting prices to increase tomorrow," he added.
Traders said exports have been bolstered by improving prices in Europe coupled with a lowering of the export tax on palm olein last month by the government.
"Buyers were gobbling up whatever oil they could get today," one trader who had a busy day said. "I decided to close early today because prices will certainly go up tomorrow."
The trader said gains in Malaysia are expected to further boost prices in Europe later on Wednesday.
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MV Jian She will leave for Malaysia on Thursday with 9,000 tonnes of palm olein.
